DESCRIPTION: FIND — `contested_count` has a logic gap where it hardcodes `current_round - oldest > 1` instead of correctly referencing the parameterized `grace_period`.
FOLLOW: Because it evaluates `> 1` (equivalent to `>= 2`), it happens to match the default `grace_period` of 2. However, passing any other `grace_period` length will be completely ignored for unresolved challenges, causing them to incorrectly enter or prematurely exit the contested finding count.
